title: Invalid API key · Please run /login
body:
**Bug Description**
I'm getting "Invalid API Key" even though I just logged in again, and again..  this seems to be only happening on one computer I SSH into. I have logged out and logged back in and restarted the computer. When I first got the error I was in the middle of a conversation and when i exited out it said I had consumed 99$ of api even though i am on the 200$ max plan.. also when logging in to check my api usage, it all says 0 (correctly)

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: cursor
- Version: 1.0.69
- Feedback ID: 

**Errors**
```json
[{"error":"Error: Could not resolve authentication method. Expected either apiKey or authToken to be set. Or for one of the \"X-Api-Key\" or \"Authorization\" headers to be explicitly omitted\n    at file:///opt/homebrew/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:1270:6454\n    at process.processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:105:5)","timestamp":"2025-08-05T21:49:53.163Z"}]
```
author: titofebus
